_readme: MACHINE-MAINTAINED. Do not hand-edit to unblock a PR — that is the exact habit issue #1509 exists to end.
This file records what main's boot payload MEASURED, not what it is ALLOWED to be.
The allowance is in orch-1083-initial-bundle-budget.mjs: baseline + PR_DELTA_ALLOWANCE.
The product limit is HARD_CEILING in that same file, and only Seth moves it.
This file only ever moves DOWN on its own: .github/workflows/bundle-baseline-ratchet.yml re-measures
after every merge to main and opens a PR lowering these numbers whenever the payload shrinks.
It moves UP only inside a PR that legitimately grew the payload, and the gate makes that growth loud.

measuredOn.note: Written by scripts/ci/bundle-baseline-update.mjs from a measured export of main. Previous: common 2532324 B, eager 3541336 B (growth: common +11,572 B, eager +11,572 B). Do not hand-edit — see the header of orch-1083-initial-bundle-budget.mjs.
